# Batch

> Batch is the only CEP with AI Decisioning. Personalize, predict and automate your Email, SMS and Push campaigns from one platform.

## Main pages

- [Batch AI - Agentic CRM and AI Decisioning](https://batch.com/batch-ai): Boost your CRM teams, predict behaviours and automate decisions with Batch AI: AI Assist, AI Predict and AI Decide. Stay in control.
- [Save the date: Batch Keynote 2027](https://batch.com/batch-keynote-2027): The Batch community's flagship event is back in Paris on 25 February. Put it in your diary!
- [Batch Data: real-time customer data platform](https://batch.com/batch-data): Batch Data, the customer data platform built into Batch: 360° profiles, business objects, real-time activation. Your data model, hosted in Europe.
- [CRM migration, fully managed by Batch](https://batch.com/crm-migration): Batch runs your CRM migration with certified experts, then stays by your side: deliverability, business reviews and dedicated support.
- [Switching to Batch, the AI-powered CEP: who and why?](https://batch.com/switch): Retail, media, finance: CRM teams across every industry are switching to Batch for its AI Decisioning and measurable performance gains.
- [Batch: the AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform (CEP)](https://batch.com/platform): Orchestrate real-time customer journeys powered by AI Decisioning: predict behaviors, personalize at scale and automate across all channels.
- [Case Studies & Success Stories - Batch](https://batch.com/customers): Discover how Batch supports 350+ clients in orchestrating omnichannel campaigns to improve customer engagement and everyday performance.
- [Batchelor Club : The trendiest CRM community](https://batch.com/batchelor-club): As a Batch customer, you automatically become a Club member.
- [Email Marketing and AI: build a winning strategy in 2025](https://batch.com/emailing): Email marketing is the backbone of any omnichannel CRM strategy. With Batch, personalize every send and optimize both deliverability and engagement.
- [Push Notifications: complete guide and AI-powered strategy](https://batch.com/notification-push): Push notifications are your most direct mobile engagement channel. With Batch, reach the right users at the right moment using predictive targeting.
- [SMS Marketing: complete guide and AI-powered strategy](https://batch.com/sms): 99% open rate, 90% within 15 min: SMS is your highest-impact CRM channel. With Batch, optimize timing and targeting for every send using AI.
- [In-App Messages: the CRM guide and AI-powered strategy](https://batch.com/message-push-inapp): In-app messages appear at the right moment inside your app. With Batch, personalize every message at scale using AI Assist, without extra effort.
- [Web Push Notifications: the guide and AI strategy](https://batch.com/web-push): Web push notifications reach your visitors without an app and remain largely underused. With Batch, trigger them at the right moment to boost engagement.
- [Personalize every customer journey with Batch AI Predict](https://batch.com/platform/customer-engagement-crm): With AI Predict, anticipate customer behaviors and deliver hyper-personalized journeys that stand out across all channels.
- [Build your CRM campaigns in minutes with AI Assist](https://batch.com/platform/crm-campaign): Intuitive interface and AI Assist suggestions: your CRM team builds omnichannel scenarios in minutes and stops depending on technical resources.
- [Maximize CRM campaign ROI with Batch AI Decisioning](https://batch.com/platform/performance-crm-campaign): Predictive scoring, send-time optimization, AI Decisioning: Batch turns your CRM data into measurable revenue impact.
- [Why choose Batch: 10 reasons to switch to the AI-powered CEP](https://batch.com/differentiators): Native AI, unified channels, real-time: discover the 10 reasons CRM teams choose Batch over the competition.
- [Finance CRM and AI: engage better, retain longer](https://batch.com/customers/finance): Banks and insurers have everything to gain from personalizing customer journeys, predicting churn risk and orchestrating compliant CRM campaigns with AI.
- [Luxury CRM and AI: develop your clienteling strategy](https://batch.com/customers/luxury): Luxury brands have everything to gain from orchestrating hyper-personalized clienteling: rare, precise and memorable campaigns, delivered at scale.
- [E-commerce CRM and AI: boost sales and customer retention](https://batch.com/customers/retail): Retail players have everything to gain from targeting high-value shoppers, reducing churn and increasing average order value with Batch's predictive targeting.
- [Media CRM and AI: engage and retain your subscribers](https://batch.com/customers/medias): Publishers and media companies have everything to gain from personalizing subscriber journeys, reducing churn and maximizing reader lifetime value with AI.
- [Batch: book a demo of the AI-powered CEP](https://batch.com/contact): See Batch in action: AI Decisioning, AI Predict, AI Assist. Book your personalized demo and join 350+ CRM teams worldwide.
- [Event Webinar — Sunrise 2026](https://batch.com/event-webinar-sunrise-2026): The Batch team will walk you through the migration from the Mobile Engagement Platform to Customer Engagement Platform.
- [Live Webinar — Batch Keynote Summer 2025 Edition](https://batch.com/webinar-batch-keynote-summer-2025): Missed the Batch Keynote Summer 2025 in Paris? Join us for a live catch-up session! 🚀
- [Become a certified expert](https://batch.com/certification-crm-marketing): Boost your career and become a certified expert with Batch.
- [Event Webinar — AI Agents - discover Batch AI](https://batch.com/event-webinar-discover-batch-ai): AI Agents for Smarter CRM : discover Batch AI
- [How top retailers win Peak Season](https://batch.com/webinar-from-black-friday-to-christmas-strategies-of-the-best-retailers): From Black Friday to Christmas: strategies from top retailers
- [Webinar — The Great Mobile Engagement Benchmark 2025](https://batch.com/webinar-the-great-mobile-engagement-benchmark-2025): What can we learn from the 2025 Mobile Engagement Benchmark, and how can these insights be turned into concrete levers for your mobile CRM campaigns?

## Blog

- [Token vs FID : are your Android pushes still landing?](https://batch.com/blog/posts/android-push-firebase-installation-id): One Firebase setting can quietly cut off your push SDKs. Batch Android SDK 3.4.1 already supports the new ID.
- [Why your emails end up in spam, and how to stop it](https://batch.com/blog/posts/high-performing-email-content-design-relevancy): Discover how content, design and relevancy work together to improve your deliverability, open rates and conversions.
- [Tracking pixels: 30% of emails have gone dark on opens](https://batch.com/blog/posts/email-tracking-pixels-consent-review-2026): Five months after the CNIL recommendations, we looked at a panel of Batch customers: how many emails still carry a tracking pixel, what happened to open rates, and how senders responded, industry by industry.
- [Q3 2026: Batch Product Updates](https://batch.com/blog/posts/batch-product-updates-q3-2026): Talk to Batch in plain language, prove what your campaigns really earn, get every email right and capture customer data without extra tools. Here's what shipped in Q3 2026.
- [Cloud Sync & Catalogs: sync your catalogs without the warehouse detour](https://batch.com/blog/posts/product-catalog-sync): Cloud Sync now pulls your CSV files over SFTP, and Catalogs replaces large catalogs in one move, without interrupting live campaigns.
- [Aggregates & Best Send Time: make your CRM decisions at the right moment](https://batch.com/blog/posts/aggregates-best-send-time-live-crm): Batch recalculates targeting and send time at execution, not at build time.
- [Deliverability: the checklist to nail your September email restart](https://batch.com/blog/posts/deliverability-checklist-september-2026): CNIL compliance, spam complaints, Postmaster Tools: the checklist to get your September and Black Friday 2026 email programme right.
- [How to improve your repurchase rate by predicting each customer's next buying date](https://batch.com/blog/posts/predict-repurchase-date-customer-conversion): Batch AI Predict's repurchase date score predicts the exact moment each customer is ready to buy again, so you can trigger the right reminder at the right time.
- [Personalized promotions: find the right offer for each customer without sacrificing your margin](https://batch.com/blog/posts/personalized-promotions-discount-customer): You can't send the biggest discount to everyone without killing your margin? Here's how to calibrate the offer per customer with AI.
- [Omnichannel CRM: how Leetchi runs email, push, and SMS on Batch](https://batch.com/blog/posts/leetchi-omnichannel-crm): Leetchi cut its email template production time in half and gained 30 points of open rate after bringing its CRM onto one platform.
- [M6 Audio migrates its 46.4M-contact mail CRM to Batch in 3 months, hitting 99.7% deliverability](https://batch.com/blog/posts/m6-audio-crm-migration): How M6 Audio migrated 46.4 million CRM contacts to Batch in 3 months, without downtime.
- [How Batch built the AI architecture behind AI assist](https://batch.com/blog/posts/generative-ai-architecture-crm): AI agents that write, translate, and optimize your CRM campaigns directly inside the product. Built on a generative AI architecture designed by Batch, evaluated for quality, and built so your customer data never leaves your control.
- [Marketing LTV: why your best future customers aren't in your VIP segment today](https://batch.com/blog/posts/marketing-ltv-exclusive-perks-future-value): Your exclusive perks go to yesterday's top customers, not tomorrow's? Here's how to target future value with predictive AI.
- [Premium range: how to maximize acquisition without diluting your positioning](https://batch.com/blog/posts/premium-range-recruitment-cross-sell-score): Want to recruit on a premium range without broadcasting it to your whole base? Here's how to target the right customers with AI.
- [Churn: how to detect cancellation signals before automatic renewal](https://batch.com/blog/posts/churn-cancellation-signals-before-renewal): Subscribers rarely cancel with a warning. Here's how Batch AI Predict's churn score lets you act before the decision is made.
- [Deep Learning: How we cut compute time 6x with Claude](https://batch.com/blog/posts/optimization-model-deep-learning-claude): How Batch's machine learning team optimized its churn prediction score, with Claude as technical copilot throughout the project.
- [CNIL pixels, post-deadline: the cost of the last-minute sprint](https://batch.com/blog/posts/cnil-pixels-post-deadline-numbers-july-14): A 1.46% opt-out rate and a deliverability squeeze: what the first post-July 14 data shows.
- [4 months to Migrate: UGC's bet on leaving its legacy CRM for Batch](https://batch.com/blog/posts/ugc-salesforce-marketing-cloud-to-batch): In just four months, UGC moved from Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Batch. Here's their story, in their own words.
- [Q2 2026 : Batch Product Updates](https://batch.com/blog/posts/batch-product-updates-q2-2026): Discover Batch's news of Q2 2026: sending piloted by AI, calendar of campaigns and automatic translation.
- [Customer loyalty: are your top customers quietly disengaging right now?](https://batch.com/blog/posts/customer-loyalty-top-customers-at-risk): Your best customers reduce spending with no prior signal? Here's how to detect the slowdown before it's done.

## Resources

- [How Castorama leverages the power of Web Push notifications](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-castorama): Discover how Castorama performed 10x better using Web Push notification rather than email. This case study reveals the different types of campaigns implemented to inform, inspire and convert its visitors.
- [How Lancôme achieved +320% Opt-In Web Push growth in 3 months](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/luxe-lancome): Discover the impact of Web Push at D+90 on Lancôme's engagement strategy
- [How did BVG Jelbi successfully deploy its omnichannel strategy with Batch?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/mobility-bvg): Discover the strategies implemented by BVG in order to differentiate itself on the Berlin Maas market and achieve growth in 1 year thanks to Batch.
- [How does BNP Paribas speed up digital adoption with Batch?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/bank-bnp-paribas): Case Study: how is BNP accelerating its digital transformation through its international mobile-first strategy?
- [Accor: Achieving +300% App Audience Growth Through Personalized Mobile Experiences](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/hospitality-accor): How did Accor achieve +300% global app audience through personalised mobile experience ?
- [How Maeva.com's personalized campaigns have generated 42% more sales in just one year!](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-maeva-en): Discover in this case study how Maeva.com achieved +42% revenue growth thanks to personalized Batch campaigns! From the brand's challenges to the results one year later, including the mechanisms implemented and the details of the CRM strategies deployed.
- [How ultra personalized campaigns boosted 24S revenues by +20%](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/luxury-24s): Discover how 24S boosts its mobile revenue by 20% thanks to its ultra-personalized campaigns, with details including the brand's challenges, our two year partnership overview and practical examples of the brand's CRM strategy.
- [How mobile.de drives app conversions with multichannel mobile engagement](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/mobile-de-marketplace-engagement-revenue-en): mobile.de replaced reach with relationships. Here's how CRM became their core mobile engagement lever, with Batch.
- [How Le Point rebuilt its CRM strategy to send 600M emails a year](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/media-lepoint-the-audiencers): Le Point looks back at its CRM transformation to engage readers, orchestrate email and push notifications on a large scale and simplify its stack with Batch.
- [Audience engagement in media: inside L’Express’ CRM approach](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/media-lexpress-piano-academy): Piano Academy 2025 replay: discover how the french media L’Express engages readers and scales a subscription-first media model with Batch.
- [Oscaro implements a highly personalized CRM strategy for its 5 million customers across Europe using Batch](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/e-commerce-oscaro): Discover how Oscaro engages 5M customers with a highly personalized CRM and optimized their marketing pressure. Download the Case Study to find out more!
- [How did Sarenza successfully deploy its omnichannel loyalty strategy with Batch?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-sarenza): Discover how Sarenza orchestrates and deploys its omnichannel loyalty strategy thanks to Batch. From the brand's stakes, to the assessment two years later, through the mechanisms put in place and the details of the CRM strategies deployed.
- [How does Lalalab optimize its segmentation and marketing pressure management?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-lalalab): Discover in this case study how Lalalab segments and optimizes the management of its marketing pressure thanks to Batch! From the brand's stakes, to the assessment one year later, through the mechanisms put in place and the details of the CRM strategies deployed.
- [How Albert Heijn achieves 16% conversion on its loyalty program with personalised In-app Messaging.](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/albert-heijn): Discover the impact of In-app Messaging How Albert Heijn achieves 16% conversion on its loyalty program with personalised.
- [Kiabi’s lightning-fast go-to-market strategy: from the vision to CRM execution to rapid growth](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-kiabi): Discover Kiabi’s lightning-fast go-to-market strategy: from the vision to CRM execution to rapid growth
- [How Kaia Health leverages Omnichannel Customer Engagement to accelerate its Go-To-Market Strategy](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/healthcare-kaia-health): Discover how Kaia Health leverages Omnichannel Customer Engagement to accelerate its Go-To-Market Strategy
- [How ManoMano generated five times more mobile sales in 12 months to maximise profitability](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-manomano): Discover ManoMano’s customer engagement strategy and use case!
- [How Resilience leverages Batch to deliver a personalized omnichannel patient experience](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/healthcare-resilience-improving-patient-experience-telehealth): Resilience's CEO and Senior CRM Manager tell us about their omnichannel strategy and how it is implemented on a day-to-day basis.
- [Printemps Group: which engagement strategy for the new Place des Tendances app?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-printemps): Printemps Group: their new app Place des Tendances mobile engagement strategy
- [Omnichannel strategy: how did FizzUp centralise all its customer data and CRM channels with Batch to optimise its 360° customer retention?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/services-fizzup): FizzUp's CEO, Digital Marketer, and Lead Tech explain how they managed to centralise all their customer data and
- [How MADSACK’s RND leverages Batch to grow Active Fans & Digital Subscriptions](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/media-madsack-rnd): Discover how German media company RND (MADSACK Group) uses Batch to increase active users and digital subscriptions.
- [European expansion: how La Redoute grows app revenue by 152% YoY leveraging the Batch Trigger Automations](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/retail-laredoute): European expansion: how La Redoute grows app revenue by 152% YoY with Batch
- [2-month CRM migration: how Potager City (Carrefour Group) switched to Batch](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/e-commerce-potager-city): How Potager City (Carrefour Group) migrated from its legacy CRM to Batch in just 2 months
- [Migrating from a Legacy CRM to Batch’s Customer Engagement Platform in 6 weeks: the Gojob case](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/services-gojob): How Gojob migrated from its legacy CRM to Batch's Customer Engagement Platform in just 6 weeks, thanks to their composable data stack.
- [How Refectory launched its omnichannel loyalty program with Batch](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/e-commerce-refectory): Attract. Engage. Retain. See how Refectory built its omnichannel loyalty program with Batch.
- [How Le Monde grows its paid Subscribers thanks to Batch?](https://batch.com/ressources/case-studies/media-le-monde): Discover in this case study how Le Monde Grows Online Paid Subscribers with 1,5% Free Trial Starts thanks to targeted messaging! From the brand's challenges to the results one year later, including the mechanisms implemented and the details of the CRM strategies deployed.
- [Subscription & Advertising Revenue for Media Companies & Publishers: From Activation to Engagement & Retention Tactics](https://batch.com/ressources/events/batch-piano-event-amsterdam): Join us for these insightful afternoon sessions, followed by drinks and nibbles to network with peers from other media and publisher companies. We will explore on and off-site engagement strategies and tactics to grow advertising revenue and subscriptions for publishers.
- [Give your customers a reason to come back: the Retention Inspiration Guide](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/retention-use-case-the-inspiration-guide): Make retention your growth lever, 30 use cases to retain and reactivate your customers.
- [NEW ⭐️ | 2024 Email Design Guide + 30 Tips & Best Practices](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/email-design-guide): Introducing Batch's 2024 Email Design Guide for CRM Experts
- [From Black Friday to Christmas: how top retailers drive results with CRM](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/peak-season-use-cases): Discover how top retailers plan, launch, and sustain high-performing CRM campaigns across the entire Peak Season, from Black Friday to Christmas.
- [Data Privacy: the true differentiators of being EU-based.](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/guide-data-privacy): Data sovereignty is a major issue in the martech ecosystem, discover in this study our position on the subject and that of our main competitors.
- [The Inspiration Guide for your Monetization Use Cases 🛎️](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/monetization-use-case-the-inspiration-guide): How can you deploy high-impact monetization campaigns across your Customer Journey? Discover 25 proven strategies in our inspiration guide.
- [A/B Testing: Top 30 campaigns from the best CRM teams](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/ab-testing): Discover how the best CRM teams in Europe use the Batch A/B Testing features.
- [Ebook: the ultimate guide to activate and engage your customers on mobile](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/ebook-retail-engage-customers): Discover how retail leaders create multi-touchpoint Customer Experience with Batch
- [How Batch helps luxury Retailers extend clienteling online?](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/study-industry-luxury): Discover how Batch, the European customer engagement platform, helps leaders in the luxury industry extend clienteling online.
- [Banks and Insurance: the guide to maximizing your digital adoption](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/ebook-banks-insurances-embracing-digital): Discover how retail leaders create multi-touchpoint Customer Experience with Batch
- [3 tips to stand out for Valentine's Day](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/crm-campaign-valentines-day): Download our guide and find out about three turnkey campaigns to help you get noticed on Valentine’s Day and get your customers to fall head over heels for your push notifications.
- [Manage your marketing pressure across all your channels!](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/marketing-pressure): Discover all our tips to manager your marketing pressure in this ebook!
- [Sales: 20+ examples of inspiring campaigns to help you stand out!](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/sales-crm-campaigns): Re-engage your dormant users and attract new customers before, during and after the sales.
- [The Inspiration Guide for your Activation Use Cases 🎢](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/activation-use-case-the-inspiration-guide): How to deploy engaging activation campaigns throughout your customer journey? Here's the ultimate guide to finding inspiring use cases.
- [Batch Email Migration Guide: ready to get started?](https://batch.com/ressources/ebook/email-migration-guide): Migration isn’t just a technical step, it’s a growth opportunity. Discover our guide to a faster, safer switch to Batch.
